benchmark.name: Lund2013-sampling-sensitivity
notes: Every sensitivity condition is derived from the native high-rate human annotations.
Ambiguity prevalence is recorded before excluded labels are removed from modelling.
The angular I-VT threshold is held constant across target sampling rates.
This analysis does not convert derived 60 Hz evidence into native 60 Hz evidence.
benchmark.reference_description: Expert RA sample labels are independently transferred to each lower-rate condition using explicit majority-window purity rules.
benchmark.task: sampling-rate and annotation-boundary sensitivity for eye-movement classification
